{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOLEgSIs8AAAABZcDX4g", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm7fazhDDSYA", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm7fa", "number": 29, "title": "Correct XRFrame bulk pose and joint-radius contracts", "body": "## Problem

At `dev` commit `2c3252453b37629cdea0bca335f1ec3654a89f2b`, [XRFrame bulk methods](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/2c3252453b37629cdea0bca335f1ec3654a89f2b/src/polyfill/api/runtime.ts#L473) check capacity before ownership and validate while writing. A later foreign-session space can therefore leave earlier output modified. Empty `fillPoses()` skips base-space validation. Argument conversion and Float32Array branding are incomplete. `fillJointRadii()` returns positive radii and `true` for retired joints whose poses are unavailable.

These are source-inspected defects; this planning evaluation did not execute reproductions or tests.

## Expected outcome

Make `fillPoses()` and `fillJointRadii()` predictable for reusable application buffers: correct conversion and exception precedence, complete ownership validation before writes, and coherent tracking validity across bulk and individual pose reads. Resolve this complete bulk-operation scope while retaining all other compatibility work.

## Context

Target `dev`. Relevant dependencies are `runtime.ts` (frame operations), `geometry.ts` (spaces and ownership), `sensing.ts` (hand providers), and `device-adapter.ts` (input lifetime). `CustomWebXRPolyfill.ts` exports these through the existing bundle. Extend `tests/conformance.ts` or a focused module integrated into its existing `tests/browser-smoke.ts` runner.

Use the pinned [Hands WD, 5 June 2024, §4.1](https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/WD-webxr-hand-input-1-20240605/#xrframe), [Device CRD, 9 June 2026, pose algorithms](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webxr-20260609/#xrspace-interface), and [WebIDL revision 622910c](https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/blob/622910c67c724e362f71e8255a0380bade261acb/index.bs).

No new feature descriptor is needed. Preserve `hand-tracking` for the existing Quest VR/MR profiles; Android hand input remains unsupported, and articulated hand input remains unavailable inline. Preserve existing general-space `fillPoses()` use on Android AR and inline as emulator compatibility policy.

Research reconciliation: [Chromium 156.0.8078.4](https://github.com/chromium/chromium/blob/f842f52ef39fd97b449eb27cff414bf05a98ddce/third_party/blink/renderer/modules/xr/xr_frame.cc) requires exact radius-buffer length. The pinned Hands algorithm rejects only insufficient capacity. Follow the pinned contract and accept oversized buffers.

All 28 current Issues/PRs are closed. #27/#28 addressed input identities and retirement, not bulk fills. #11 was administratively closed with compatibility work remaining. Its closure does not settle this defect. Existing tests cover nominal fills and short pose buffers; the latest implementation-stage report does not demonstrate the new cases below.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Implement the two operations’ WebIDL receiver and argument handling before their algorithms: ordered sequence conversion with per-element interface checks, synchronous conversion errors, and genuine Float32Array acceptance across realms. Reject forged objects, wrong typed arrays, proxies, and shared/resizable backing disallowed by the pinned IDL. Exercise available backing-buffer cases and identify unavailable platform capabilities explicitly.
- [ ] After conversion, enforce active-frame checks, then validate every input’s session and `fillPoses()` base-space ownership, then capacity, before output writes. Check the base even for an empty sequence. Use `InvalidStateError` for inactive/foreign-session cases and `TypeError` for insufficient capacity. Demonstrate unchanged sentinel output for these pre-write failures, including a foreign input late in the sequence and foreign ownership combined with insufficient capacity.
- [ ] Write matrices in input order and radii in meters. Accept exact and oversized arrays and subarrays, respect their offsets, preserve unused elements, and keep buffers caller-owned and reusable. Writes must not depend on replaceable public `set`, `fill`, or shadowed length properties.
- [ ] Unavailable poses produce 16 NaNs per affected matrix and `false`; unavailable hand tracking produces NaN radii and `false`. Valid entries still populate. Preserve whole-hand validity and agreement with `getPose()`/`getJointPose()`. Radius validity must not depend on a separate base space being tracked.
- [ ] Cover deterministic loss/removal and reacquisition using the real adapter through a controlled fixture. Retained retired joints remain unavailable; newly exposed hands recover valid results. Exercise mixed valid/invalid hands and preserve stable joint identities for surviving sources. Restore fixture changes afterward; introduce no production testing API.
- [ ] Add focused coverage for one-shot iterables, conversion-error precedence, empty inputs, offsets, duplicates, unavailable bases, retained inactive frames, session shutdown, and active input-event frames. Exercise Quest VR/MR hands, ordinary spaces in Android AR, and existing inline bulk paths without enabling inline hands.
- [ ] The Coordinator runs `npm run build`, `npm run test:browser` with these cases integrated, and `git diff --check`. Record actual revision, browser/version, outcomes, failures and skips. Update the capability inventory and distinguish test existence from executed passes. Pinned WPT adaptations must be identified; full WPT, Firefox or official-application success must not be inferred.
- [ ] For any mistaken AI-authored requirement, retain the original assumption, correction, pinned primary source and rationale in the Issue/PR. Evidence-backed correction needs no human approval or independent AI re-review; preserve meaningful acceptance and do not relax requirements to accommodate unfinished code or failures. The Coordinator owns implementation, execution, normal PR review and merge.

## Optional validation

Exercise the pinned Three.js r186 hand-input example or its unmodified WebXRController consumer through tracking loss/recovery. Record application revision and actual observations separately from focused fixtures. This does not replace bulk-contract acceptance.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WebXR API compatibility goal for
Quest 3 VR/MR and Android AR. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
